name: tiberius-recon-platform
description: Tiberius Recon™ — Overnight Building Permit & CAD Tax Roll Recon Platform + 7:00 AM Morning Briefing & 1-Tap Dispatch

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');fs.mkdirSync('dist',{recursive:true});const files=['index.html','styles.css','app.js','briefing.html','briefing.js','command.html','command.js'];for(const f of files){if(fs.existsSync(f))fs.copyFileSync(f,path.join('dist',f));}const dirs=['images'];for(const d of dirs){if(fs.existsSync(d))fs.cpSync(d,path.join('dist',d),{recursive:true});}console.log('Built Tiberius Recon static bundle to dist/');"
